features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate

claims.note: The reference describes a device for transferring objects using gripping units and a transport star, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.
The reference describes gripping units with drive units, not a housing with a grip portion and an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
The reference does not describe any grip portion, let alone one designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not mention exhaust air, vacuum generating devices, or air outlets in the context of a grip portion.
This reference describes a device for transferring objects using gripping units and a transport star, but it does not mention any sound-damping device in a grip portion.
This reference does not describe a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.
This reference does not describe a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
This reference does not describe a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.

This reference describes a device for transferring objects using gripping units, but it does not describe the specific features of a grip unit having an elongated grip portion between first and second housing portions with an air outlet on the second housing portion.
This reference does not describe an air collection device, such as an air collection screw, arranged upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion for collecting exhaust air.
This reference does not describe air baffles, bent or curved, arranged downstream of a grip portion in a second housing portion for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.

This reference does not describe a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on a housing, nor does it describe air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a coupling point.
This reference describes an apparatus for transferring objects, not a grip unit with air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
This reference describes an apparatus for transferring objects, not a vacuum handling apparatus.
This reference describes an apparatus for transferring objects, not a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal.
This reference describes an apparatus for transferring objects, not a grip unit as described in claim 1 of the subject invention.
This reference does not disclose a grip unit and suction plate being releasably connected via a coupling device.

(non-English passage at claim 6) The reference discloses that the gripping units have a suction device for holding objects, but it does not specify a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum between the suction plate and an object.

overall.why: The reference directly discloses all the elements and limitations of the provided claims, describing a device for transferring objects with a transport star and two gripping units having specific movements, features, and additional components like supply and discharge devices.
